title.en: Practice: Series, clocks and calendars: finding the rule

section: Practice (written by us, not from a UPSC paper): Series, clocks and calendars: finding the rule

en.why: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next is 12: 30 + 12 = 42. The terms are also 1 x 2, 2 x 3, up to 6 x 7 = 42.
Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9. The next difference is 11, so the term is 27 + 11 = 38.
Each term is the sum of the two before it: 8 + 13 = 21.
Each term is a square plus one: 1 + 1, 4 + 1, 9 + 1, 16 + 1, 25 + 1. Next is 36 + 1 = 37. The differences 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 give the same answer.

en.stem: Find the next letter: A, C, F, J, O, ?
en.why: Positions are 1, 3, 6, 10, 15. Differences are 2, 3, 4, 5, so add 6: 21, which is U.

en.stem: Which number does not belong with the others: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125?
en.why: 8, 27, 64 and 125 are the cubes of 2, 3, 4 and 5. 100 is not a cube.
Two series are mixed. Odd places: 4, 8, 12, next 16. Even places: 7, 14, 21. The next term is in an odd place, so it is 16. The option 28 continues the wrong series.

en.stem: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3:30?
en.why: Minute hand: 30 x 6 = 180 degrees. Hour hand: 3.5 x 30 = 105 degrees. Difference = 75 degrees. Ninety ignores the movement of the hour hand.

en.stem: At what time between 4 and 5 o'clock are the two hands of a clock together?
en.why: At 4:00 the hour hand is 120 degrees ahead. The minute hand gains 5.5 degrees a minute, so it needs 120 / 5.5 = 240 / 11 = 21 and 9/11 minutes.

en.stem: A clock gains 5 minutes every hour. It is set right at 8 a.m. What time will it show when the correct time is 8 p.m. on the same day?
en.why: True time elapsed = 12 hours. Gain = 12 x 5 = 60 minutes. The clock shows 9:00 p.m.

en.stem: How many times do the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock coincide in 12 hours?
en.why: The hands meet once in a little over 65 minutes, so in 12 hours they meet 11 times. Between 11 and 1 they meet only once, at 12.

en.stem: If 1 March of a year is a Monday, what day of the week is 1 April of the same year?
en.why: March has 31 days, which is 4 weeks and 3 odd days. Three days after Monday is Thursday.

en.stem: 15 August 2021 was a Sunday. What day of the week was 15 August 2022?
en.why: The period has 365 days, since no 29 February falls in it (2022 is not a leap year). One odd day: Sunday moves to Monday.

en.stem: Which of the following is a leap year?
en.why: A century year is a leap year only if divisible by 400. 2000 is; 1900 and 2100 are not. 2022 is not divisible by 4.

en.stem: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
en.why: 100 = 14 x 7 + 2, so there are 2 odd days. Two days after Wednesday is Friday.
